description: A small recipe helper chatbot. It suggests simple meal ideas from a local recipe list and remembers a few preferences during a conversation.

recipes.name: Tomato pasta
recipes.method: Cook the pasta, warm tomato and garlic in a pan, then mix together with a little olive oil.

recipes.name: Chickpea salad
recipes.method: Mix chickpeas, cucumber and tomato, then add lemon juice and seasoning.

recipes.name: Egg fried rice
recipes.method: Fry rice with peas, stir in beaten egg, and finish with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Bean chilli
recipes.method: Cook onion with spices, add beans and tomato, and simmer until thick.

recipes.name: Overnight oats
recipes.method: Mix oats with milk and yoghurt, add banana, and chill until breakfast.

recipes.name: Vegetable noodle stir fry
recipes.method: Stir fry vegetables and garlic, add noodles, and season with soy sauce.

recipes.name: Tuna wrap
recipes.method: Mix tuna, sweetcorn and yoghurt, then roll into a wrap.

recipes.name: Baked potato with beans
recipes.method: Cook the potato, warm the beans, and top with cheese.

responses: Hi {name}. I can suggest a simple meal from the recipe list.
Hello {name}. Tell me what ingredients you have, or ask for breakfast, lunch or dinner ideas.
